auth_tokens_authorization_complete.name: auth_tokens_authorization_complete
auth_tokens_authorization_complete.value: ("auth_tokens"."authorized_at" IS NULL AND "auth_tokens"."authorized_by" IS NULL AND "auth_tokens"."verification_method" IS NULL) OR ("auth_tokens"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_tokens"."verification_method" IS NOT NULL AND ("auth_tokens"."authorized_by" IS NULL) = ("auth_tokens"."verification_method" = 'ceremony'))

auth_tokens_used_requires_authorization.name: auth_tokens_used_requires_authorization
auth_tokens_used_requires_authorization.value: "auth_tokens"."used_at" IS NULL OR "auth_tokens"."authorized_at" IS NOT NULL

user_roles_grantor_valid.name: user_roles_grantor_valid
user_roles_grantor_valid.value: ("user_roles"."grant_source" = 'grant' AND "user_roles"."granted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "user_roles"."granted_by" <> "user_roles"."user_id" AND "user_roles"."grant_reference" IS NULL) OR ("user_roles"."grant_source" IN ('bootstrap', 'recovery') AND "user_roles"."granted_by" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."grant_reference" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("user_roles"."grant_reference")) BETWEEN 3 AND 200)

students_given_names_clean.name: students_given_names_clean
students_given_names_clean.value: "students"."given_names" = btrim("students"."given_names") AND "students"."given_names" !~ '\s{2,}' AND "students"."given_names" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' AND char_length("students"."given_names") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

students_family_name_clean.name: students_family_name_clean
students_family_name_clean.value: "students"."family_name" = btrim("students"."family_name") AND "students"."family_name" !~ '\s{2,}' AND "students"."family_name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' AND char_length("students"."family_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100

pga_revocation_consistent.name: pga_revocation_consistent
pga_revocation_consistent.value: ("prefect_group_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "prefect_group_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("prefect_group_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "prefect_group_assignments"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

pga_reason_clean.name: pga_reason_clean
pga_reason_clean.value: "prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason" IS NULL OR ("prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason" = btrim("prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason") AND "prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' AND char_length("prefect_group_assignments"."revocation_reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 200)

att_days_finalized_consistent.name: att_days_finalized_consistent
att_days_finalized_consistent.value: ("attendance_days"."status" = 'draft' AND "attendance_days"."finalized_by" IS NULL AND "attendance_days"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_days"."status" = 'finalized' AND "attendance_days"."finalized_by" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_days"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)

att_events_shape.name: att_events_shape
att_events_shape.value:
("attendance_events"."event_type" = 'mark_changed' AND "attendance_events"."record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_events"."request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_events"."payload_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_events"."new_status" IN ('present', 'absent') AND ("attendance_events"."old_status" IS NULL OR "attendance_events"."old_status" IN ('present', 'absent')))
        OR ("attendance_events"."event_type" IN ('day_opened', 'day_finalized') AND "attendance_events"."record_id" IS NULL AND "attendance_events"."request_id" IS NULL AND "attendance_events"."payload_hash" IS NULL AND "attendance_events"."old_status" IS NULL AND "attendance_events"."new_status" IS NULL)

att_records_marked_consistent.name: att_records_marked_consistent
att_records_marked_consistent.value: ("attendance_records"."status" IS NULL AND "attendance_records"."marked_by" IS NULL AND "attendance_records"."marked_at" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_records"."status" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_records"."marked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_records"."marked_at" IS NOT NULL)

mdr_jwk_valid.name: mdr_jwk_valid
mdr_jwk_valid.value:
jsonb_typeof("mobile_device_requests"."public_key_jwk") = 'object' AND ("mobile_device_requests"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'kty') = 'EC' AND ("mobile_device_requests"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'crv') = 'P-256'
      AND ("mobile_device_requests"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'x') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$' AND ("mobile_device_requests"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'y') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$' AND ("mobile_device_requests"."public_key_jwk" -> 'd') IS NULL

mdr_claim_consistent.name: mdr_claim_consistent
mdr_claim_consistent.value: ("mobile_device_requests"."status" <> 'pending' OR "mobile_device_requests"."user_id" IS NULL) AND ("mobile_device_requests"."status" NOT IN ('claimed', 'approved', 'activated') OR ("mobile_device_requests"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mobile_device_requests"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL))

mdr_approval_consistent.name: mdr_approval_consistent
mdr_approval_consistent.value: ("mobile_device_requests"."approved_by" IS NULL) = ("mobile_device_requests"."approved_at" IS NULL) AND ("mobile_device_requests"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'activated') OR "mobile_device_requests"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("mobile_device_requests"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "mobile_device_requests"."approved_by" <> "mobile_device_requests"."user_id")

md_jwk_valid.name: md_jwk_valid
md_jwk_valid.value:
jsonb_typeof("mobile_devices"."public_key_jwk") = 'object' AND ("mobile_devices"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'kty') = 'EC' AND ("mobile_devices"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'crv') = 'P-256'
      AND ("mobile_devices"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'x') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$' AND ("mobile_devices"."public_key_jwk" ->> 'y') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$' AND ("mobile_devices"."public_key_jwk" -> 'd') IS NULL

md_revocation_consistent.name: md_revocation_consistent
md_revocation_consistent.value: ("mobile_devices"."status" = 'revoked') = ("mobile_devices"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("mobile_devices"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("mobile_devices"."revoke_reason" IS NULL)
